text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list:
Congratulations, you really gave it your 
all!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank you very much. I was able to 
show everyone my ideal run.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, this victory is merely a stepping 
stone. I shall continue to forge ahead 
without growing complacent.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Toward the "pinnacle" where I ought to 
reach.
choice_data_list: Embracing victory is a queen's duty, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Toward the "pinnacle" where I ought to 
reach.
choice_data_list: Embracing victory is a queen's duty, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The "pinnacle" exists only at the end of 
layer upon layer of victories―― I cannot 
take that journey lightly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Would you keep me company for a bit, then? 
There's a restaurant I'd love to recommend 
for raising a celebratory toast.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Naturally. I must continue to push 
them aside, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As the queen. Every single "obstacle" 
keeping me from the heights—!
